components.description_en: Identify prefixes that express negation in Portuguese
components.cc_component_description: Identify common prefixes such as re-, un-, and pre- as clues to word meaning

components.description_en: Form antonyms by adding negation prefixes to base words
components.cc_component_description: Apply knowledge of common prefixes to determine the meaning of new words

cc_matches.description: Use the most frequently occurring inflections and affixes (e.g., -ed, -s, re-, un-, pre-, -ful, -less) as a clue to the meaning of an unknown word.
Determine the meaning of the new word formed when a known prefix is added to a known word (e.g., happy/unhappy, tell/retell).
